customDescriptions.value: Access camera and audio peripherals on Raspberry Pi — use for video capture, image processing, or audio recording/playback on Pi hardware
Access basic I/O on Raspberry Pi — use for GPIO read/write, PWM output, or general-purpose digital interfacing on Pi boards
Access communication interfaces on Raspberry Pi — use for I2C, SPI, UART, or serial communication with external devices
Access IoT connectivity on Raspberry Pi — use for MQTT, ThingSpeak, or cloud-based data exchange in IoT applications
Access network interfaces on Raspberry Pi — use for TCP/IP, UDP, or Ethernet communication in networked embedded systems
Access the Raspberry Pi Sense HAT add-on board — use for reading environmental sensors, IMU data, or controlling the 8x8 LED matrix
Access external sensor modules on Raspberry Pi — use for reading temperature, humidity, distance, or other sensor data from connected peripherals
Access utility functions on Raspberry Pi — use for system control, timing, file operations, or shell command execution on the Pi
